pr_title: Respect gateway allocations in DB computer
pr_body:
If one of the gateway allocators initializes a shard somewhere then the spawned desired balance computation should start from a state with that shard initializing. Today it doesn't, but this commit fixes that.

Closes #91451
Closes #91613
pr_comments: Hi @DaveCTurner, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

Unfortunately that didn't work because the `ReplicaShardAllocator` also sometimes fails an `INITIALIZING` shard to cancel a recovery in favour of a more efficient recovery elsewhere. Tracking all these changes individually seems too complicated now, so I've opted for just rebuilding the routing table if needed.
Ok this is good to go now @idegtiarenko, the failure I found in the new approach was just a test bug it seems.

review_comments: NIT: may be this could be converted to a record?

It's not a `static` class. I mean yes we could pass in a reference to the `DesiredBalanceShardsAllocator` explicitly, but I don't see the benefit. Also I don't want the `toString()` to contain the whole desired balance really, just the index is enough.
